about_the_game:
The Deluxe Upgrade Pack includes the following content:
- Additional DLC
- Digital Artbook & Mini Soundtrack

ADDITIONAL DLC
This product is an additional DLC that includes additional Nightfarers and bosses.

ARTBOOK & MINI SOUNDTRACK
This application allows players to enjoy viewing concept art and listening to in-game music of ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN exclusive to the ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN Deluxe Edition and Deluxe Upgrade Pack.

*Additional DLC will be available by Q4 2025.
*The Deluxe Upgrade Pack will only be available to purchase until the release of Additional DLC.
